description: Update an existing campaign in place: revise asset text/threadPosts/images/PDF documentUrl/videoUrl/firstComment/pageId/SEO metadata, add new social or CMS platform assets to the same campaign, rename the campaign title, generate a Client Review Link, or remove specific assets while automatically syncing any pending scheduled posts. Note: this saves edits in WordFlux without altering already-published external CMS posts; if the post is already live on a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, Ghost, Shopify, Webhook, or Hosted Blog), show the updated preview and ask the user for confirmation before calling wordflux_publish_now(contentId) to push the update live in place. When attaching or updating an image across channels, ALWAYS ask the user first if they want to insert the image as-is (autoFormatForPlatforms: false) or also smart-crop it for each channel optimal dimensions (autoFormatForPlatforms: true). Always summarize changes and offer further tweaks, scheduling, or live publishing.

addAsNewAsset.description: Single-asset shorthand: set true to add a separate asset even if this platform already exists on the campaign

assetId.description: Single-asset shorthand: existing assetId to update (use assets[] for multi-asset updates)

assets.description: Batch list of platform assets to update in place or add to this campaign

addAsNewAsset.description: Set true to force adding an extra asset even if an asset for this platform already exists (e.g. Company Page + Personal Profile)

assetId.description: Existing asset UUID to update (from wordflux_get_content or wordflux_list_content). If omitted, matches by platform (+ pageId) or adds a new asset.

authorProfileId.description: Optional updated Author Profile UUID for Hosted Blog

base64Images.description: Optional Base64 or Data URI images to attach

clearImages.description: Set true to remove attached images from this asset

content.description: Updated or new post/article body copy for this asset

documentTitle.description: Optional updated LinkedIn PDF carousel title

documentUrl.description: Optional updated HTTPS PDF URL for LinkedIn carousels

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

imageUrl.description: Optional single HTTPS image URL to attach

imageUrls.description: Optional HTTPS image URLs array to attach

integrationId.description: Optional connected integration UUID from wordflux_list_brands. Use this (or pageName) to target a specific site/account when multiple WordPress websites, Shopify stores, Webflow/Ghost sites, or social accounts are connected to the same brand, or include multiple targets[] entries with different integrationIds to send to several sites at once.

metaDescription.description: Optional updated SEO meta description / excerpt

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Optional ChatGPT user-uploaded or AI-generated image file references (openaiFileIdRefs) to attach

pageId.description: Optional destination pageId or CMS collectionId

platform.description: Target platform (required when adding a brand-new channel asset to the campaign)

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

slug.description: Optional updated custom URL slug for Hosted Blog or CMS

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into PNGs and attach

threadPosts.description: Optional updated multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon

videoUrl.description: Optional updated HTTPS MP4/MOV video URL

wordpressCategoryIds.description: Optional updated WordPress category IDs array

authorProfileId.description: Optional Author Profile UUID for Hosted Blog attribution

autoFormatForPlatforms.description: Ask the user first: set true to smart focal-crop attached images to each channel optimal aspect ratio (e.g. 4:5/1:1 for Instagram & LinkedIn, 16:9 for Blog/CMS), or false (default) to insert the original image as-is.

content.description: Single-asset shorthand: updated or new post/article copy

contentId.description: Campaign contentId to update in place

createReviewLink.description: Optional: set true to generate a shareable no-login Client Review URL (/review/:token)

documentTitle.description: Single-asset shorthand: LinkedIn PDF carousel title

documentUrl.description: Single-asset shorthand: HTTPS PDF URL for LinkedIn carousels

embedLinkPreview.description: Embed a native link preview card on supported platforms (LinkedIn, Facebook, Bluesky, Threads) when no image or video is attached. Defaults to true.

expectedVersionNumber.description: Optional versionNumber from wordflux_get_content to prevent overwriting newer edits made in WordFlux Studio

linkSocialToCmsPermalink.description: Set true when publishing both a CMS/Hosted Blog article and social channels together so WordFlux publishes the article first and injects its live canonical URL (+ UTM parameters) into the social posts

openaiFileIdRefs.description: Array of user-uploaded or AI-generated image files from ChatGPT to persist and attach

platform.description: Single-asset shorthand: target platform to update in place or add as a new channel asset on this campaign

previewUrl.description: Optional URL to use for the native link preview card when no image or video is attached

removeAssetIds.description: Optional asset UUIDs to remove from the campaign (at least one asset must remain)

sourceUrl.description: Optional webpage URL to scrape og:image from or attach as source metadata

svgImages.description: Optional SVG XML strings or data:image/svg+xml Data URIs to rasterize into PNGs and attach

threadPosts.description: Single-asset shorthand: updated multi-post thread items for X/Twitter, Threads, Bluesky, or Mastodon

videoUrl.description: Single-asset shorthand: HTTPS MP4/MOV video URL
